name: Black Hawk County, IA
findings: Black Hawk County has 561 nonprofit organizations. 150 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 117 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Black Hawk County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Black Hawk County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 83 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 47 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few community organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 community organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through community groups? Where else does that happen?
